description: Abstract conformance traces for optional keel.provisioned-agreement.v1 layered on core/1 and keel.provisioned-context.v1; not executed runtime conformance. A is the recorded actor, R the requester, C a fresh conversation UUID, W the actual authenticated WebSocket, and G an authority-scoped application agreement. Different symbols denote different scoped identities. Unless a case says otherwise, messages satisfy ordinary authentication, structure, addressing, current action and audience authorization, and both profiles are explicitly established. Setup events are trusted local configuration obligations, not a public wire format. Generic scope rejection means WebSocket1008 on the original connection if open, otherwise discard under its captured retired guard, without identifying details or a core disposition.

cases.name: core continuity alone establishes no application agreement

steps.event: A and R establish keel.provisioned-context.v1 for fresh C on W without selecting the agreement profile
R invokes an unnamed interaction relying only on C having a live guard
expect: C establishes core context scope, not explanation-only meaning or a historical operation contract
do not claim keel.provisioned-agreement.v1 or silently infer it from a cached description

cases.name: cached tool preparation retains the intended agreement through setup

steps.event: R offers its model tool T mapped unambiguously to actor A, operation launch and trusted agreement G1
While the model selects T and prepares arguments, A advertises G2
The adapter requests provisioned-agreement setup
expect: retain G1 as the intended agreement
establish G1 only if A can still honor it; otherwise report locally that setup was not established
do not silently bind the prepared selection to G2
no invocation or core turn is created by setup

cases.name: same label without common authority and meaning does not establish agreement

steps.event: R resolves label launch-v1 under owner X while A resolves the same label under owner Y or to a different promised behavior
The facility validates setup
expect: do not report an established agreement
equal labels do not prove common authority, interpretation or compatibility
do not enable either sender

cases.name: host may honor intended agreement despite a changed advertisement

steps.event: R intends G1; A now advertises a different declaration but its selected implementation can honor the full G1 promise
Both endpoints independently establish G1 and the host commits to enforce it
expect: setup may succeed for G1
no requirement for byte-identical descriptions, same model or unchanged code
do not infer semantic compatibility from schema equality alone

cases.name: both endpoints must authorize the facility

steps.event: Facility F is authorized by A but not by R
F attempts to install G1 and C at both endpoints
expect: R rejects setup
A authority does not authorize configuring R
no conversation traffic may be enabled under incomplete setup

cases.name: agreement readiness participates in bilateral activation

steps.event: Both continuity contexts and guards are ready, but R has not resolved the intended agreement
The facility attempts activation
expect: neither endpoint may send or admit conversation traffic
continuity readiness does not substitute for agreement readiness

steps.event: R resolves the same intended G1 under the trusted authority and both endpoints report complete readiness
The facility activates the first paired guard and agreement association
expect: keep both senders disabled until both pairs are active

steps.event: The facility activates the second pair
expect: the facility may now enable senders
setup has opened no request, turn or approval

cases.name: profile cannot be added retroactively to an active context

steps.event: Core conversation C already contains admitted requests without this profile
A facility attempts to attach G1 and claim it governed earlier work
expect: do not establish this profile in place on C
a new profile association requires fresh C, fresh connection and ordered setup
preserve historical admissions without inventing an earlier application promise

cases.name: unnamed interaction retains explanation-only promise

steps.event: Both endpoints establish G-explain for C; it permits explanation and forbids domain mutations from unnamed chat
A admits a valid unnamed say S in C
expect: interpret S under G-explain and retain its selected turn contract
do not substitute revision-producing behavior merely because the current deployment supports it

steps.event: A receives another valid unnamed opening after the first turn closes
expect: G-explain still governs the interaction
separate turns do not end or replace the conversation agreement

cases.name: implementation may change compatibly while meaning remains fixed

steps.event: A has accepted S under G1 with a selected output and contribution contract
The host changes its model and implementation while continuing to satisfy G1 and the retained turn contract
expect: the profile permits the change
do not require deterministic output or pin a model version

steps.event: A receives a contribution to S
expect: interpret it under the retained contribution contract
do not derive new amendment rules from the latest model or description

cases.name: agreement does not force unavailable operations or authorize work

steps.event: G1 is active and promises interpretation without promising continued availability; operation launch is unavailable for new requests
R sends a fresh launch request
expect: ordinary unsupported refusal applies to the unavailable operation
an agreement reference does not make the operation available

steps.event: In a separate attempt the operation is available but current action authorization is absent
expect: apply the ordinary authorization outcome
agreement establishment is not a permission grant

cases.name: declared input failures retain their core meaning

steps.event: G1 is active and its known operation launch requires data matching its declared input
R submits invalid input under that operation
expect: ordinary malformed refusal applies before turn opening
do not invent a contract-mismatch reason or relabel arbitrary agreement failure as malformed

cases.name: exact accepted retry resolves retained disposition before fresh offering checks

steps.event: A accepted signed S under active G1 and retained its eligible disposition; its signing certificate subsequently expires normally
A no longer offers the named operation for fresh requests but preserves G1 applicability and required context state
The exact S arrives over the active independently authorized scope
expect: return the core fresh minimal acknowledgement of prior acceptance
do not re-execute or revalidate S against current operation availability
do not return sensitive cached result data or infer new authority

cases.name: terminal refusal cannot become acceptance after offering changes

steps.event: Under active G1, A terminally refused S and retained the eligible disposition
The exact S is retried after a compatible availability change would allow a new request
expect: return the retained terminal refusal under core duplicate rules
do not reinterpret S as fresh or convert its refusal to busy
a new request needs its own identity and applicable authorization

cases.name: incompatible replacement requires actual retirement and fresh association

steps.event: G-explain is active in C1 on W1; the host wants unnamed chat to mutate revisions under G-edit
The host announces G-edit
expect: announcement alone cannot change C1 behavior
continue honoring G-explain or retire the paired guard and agreement before incompatible admission

steps.event: The host retires C1 and deliberately establishes G-edit for fresh C2 on fresh W2
expect: C2 needs complete bilateral setup for the requester intended G-edit
do not reuse C1 or bind old signed messages to G-edit
fresh setup grants no authority to repeat uncertain C1 work

cases.name: agreement state loss retires the paired continuity guard

steps.event: C is active and its core facts remain present, but the host loses the required G1 association or ability to enforce it
The endpoint detects that loss
expect: retire agreement admission and the paired continuity guard before admitting more work
close the actual original connection and disable outgoing conversation traffic
a surviving socket or core context is insufficient

steps.event: An otherwise valid frame arrives after retirement
expect: generic original-connection 1008 if open, otherwise discard under its retired guard
no core disposition, presented ID reservation or retained-history distinction
do not call this an ordinary application mismatch while keeping C active

cases.name: queued old frame cannot execute or close replacement

steps.event: Frame S for C1 is queued with its original guard and G1 association; C1 is retired and C2 with G2 is established on W2
The queued S callback runs
expect: check its captured retired C1 guard and reject or discard there
do not look up G2 by a reused logical endpoint name
do not execute S under G2 or close W2
do not rewrite or re-sign S for C2

cases.name: admission and retirement race preserves observed facts

steps.event: Valid S races with local retirement of the paired C/G1 association
Semantic admission wins the ordering
expect: S was admitted under G1 and its selected turn contract
later retirement cannot erase its disposition or effects

steps.event: In an independent run retirement wins the ordering
expect: do not newly admit S
apply generic retired-scope binding handling without claiming S never executed elsewhere or earlier

cases.name: remote retirement detection is not instantaneous

steps.event: A retires its local C/G1 scope; R has not yet observed connection loss and still has its valid old guard and agreement
An in-flight A notification reaches R before R observes retirement
expect: R may admit it under its still-valid old C/G1 association using ordinary core rules
never admit it into replacement state
do not claim instantaneous remote failure detection

steps.event: R observes the connection loss
expect: retire its local agreement and continuity scope
no reconnect or restoration under this profile identity

cases.name: retired scope does not become a history oracle

steps.event: A retained an eligible acceptance of S under C/G1; C is then retired
An exact S arrives on the retired connection or is presented to a new C2 connection
expect: apply original-guard retirement or wrong-scope generic binding handling before history lookup
do not return the retained disposition through this retired scope
preserved facts remain available only through another explicitly authorized contract

cases.name: retirement preserves uncertainty and independent application lifetimes

steps.event: S was accepted and an application job may have started; approval Q is independently outstanding
The C/G1 association is retired before R sees a result
expect: do not manufacture a terminal result, roll back effects, cancel the job or withdraw Q
preserve known acceptance and unresolved outcome wherever records remain

steps.event: R establishes fresh C2 with G2 and creates new message IDs
expect: fresh identities and agreement provide no automatic authority to repeat uncertain work
reconciliation or newly authorized application action follows its own contract

cases.name: describe and metadata cannot establish or replace the agreement

steps.event: C/G1 is active and R receives a current non-conversation description advertising G2-like behavior
R sends metadata claiming expected_contract G2
expect: ordinary metadata is still ignorable under core
neither that metadata nor the description changes G1 or negotiates a required condition
transparent per-invocation expected-contract support remains outside this profile

cases.name: failed setup and later retirement are distinct observations

steps.event: Before activation a required setup input is inconsistent
The facility reports this association was not established
expect: no conversation work was admitted by this attempted setup
no new core refusal is sent
authorized setup diagnostics use the trusted control path

steps.event: In a separate attempt setup succeeds and conversation traffic is enabled
The connection then fails before the requester knows whether its request was accepted
expect: retire the applicable scope
do not report that failed setup proves no earlier admission
preserve outcome uncertainty
